name: Keyword Spotting (MFCC-SNN)
description: 35-class spoken keyword recognition on Google Speech Commands v2 using MFCC features fed into a spiking neural network. Primary metric is top-1 classification accuracy. Evaluated via the upstream NeuroBench library using MFCCPreProcessor. Note: Speech2Spikes (S2SPreProcessor) is proprietary and is explicitly blocked — this benchmark uses open MFCC preprocessing only. Reference task from NeuroBench v1.0.
